description: Continue an existing H3 clip past its end and get back ONE joined clip (source + new footage). The last 22 frames and their audio guide the start of a new H3 render, so motion, character and voice carry across the seam; chain calls to go past H3's 15 s limit. Adds (frames - 22)/24 seconds: 124 -> +4.25 s, 243 -> +9.2 s, 362 -> +14.2 s. Source must be a 24 fps clip WITH an audio track and width/height multiples of 32 (any H3 output qualifies); output keeps the source size. Prompt describes only what happens NEXT, in the same style line + SHOT + (S1): <d>[English] words</d> + 'Audio:' format. MiniMax H3 FL2VA + 4-step 768p turbo LoRA, ~2-3 min. ~44GB RAM peak: needs swap and nothing else on the GPU. Long jobs return status 'running': poll get_job_result with wait_seconds.

prompt.description: What happens next (style line + SHOT lines + dialogue + 'Audio:' line)

input_video.description: Clip to extend (local mp4/mkv path, uploaded automatically); 24 fps with audio

frames.description: New-segment length at 24 fps incl. the 22-frame overlap, snapped up to 5+17n (124 adds ~4.25 s)
